name: SystemExit/return mapping

example: --apply --baseline on fx/ob wrote 5 files + runs/ + state/ (W3 OB3)

name: --baseline
effect: stateful scan with cwd .somnus-debug/ into runs/baseline.{md,json}; skipped silently unless verify status is 0 (verify exit 1 counts as status 0)
failure_behavior: without --apply and no config -> 'use --apply first', exit 1
example: onboard.py repo --baseline (no config) -> exit 1 (W3 OB2); verify exit=1 still recorded baseline (W3 OB3)

name: --new-config
precedence: default: adopt first ROOT python_doctor.yaml/.yml; flag forces .somnus-debug/python_doctor.yaml
effect: ignore an existing root doctor config and generate a profile config instead
example: root python_doctor.yaml present: plan adopts it (WARN 2 of 3 files); --new-config -> 'generate on --apply' (W3 OB4/OB5)

name: --python
precedence: --python > project venvs (.venv, venv, env, any pyvenv.cfg dir) > somnus-debug on PATH
effect: interpreter that runs python -m somnus_debug.cli
failure_behavior: path is resolve()d, so a symlinked venv python loses the venv -> BLOCKED exit 3; nonexistent path -> FileNotFoundError traceback exit 1
example: --python /nonexistent/python -> traceback exit 1 (W3 OB6)

name: PATH lookup of somnus-debug
effect: fallback runner when no --python and no project venv has somnus_debug
example: no somnus-debug on PATH -> 'BLOCKED: no usable somnus-debug', exit 3 (W3 OB8)

name: PYTHONPATH extension (src layout)
precedence: prepended to any inherited PYTHONPATH
effect: child doctor runs resolve the project's own src packages

name: PROFILE_DIR
effect: profile directory; generated doctor config sets state_dir: .somnus-debug/state

name: generated .somnus-debug/python_doctor.yaml
default: init-config output with include [*.py], ignore BASE_IGNORES + venvs + egg-info + git-ignored py dirs, state_dir .somnus-debug/state
effect: profile doctor config; header comment documents fnmatch semantics

name: generated .somnus-debug/pycache.yaml
default: roots [absolute repo], name-only excludes, dry_run: true
effect: safe cleaner config; live run requires editing dry_run

name: ALWAYS_PRUNE / BASE_IGNORES / PYCACHE_EXCLUDES / VENV_NAMES
effect: survey pruning and the ignore/exclude lists written into generated configs

name: subprocess timeouts
default: 600 s (scans); 60 s (version, init-config, git, import probe)
effect: TimeoutExpired propagates as a traceback

name: onboard exit codes
valid_values: 0 ok, 1 usage, 2 coverage failure, 3 somnus-debug unavailable
failure_behavior: doctor config error -> RuntimeError traceback exit 1, not 2 (D-20)

name: baseline
failure_behavior: unreadable / missing issues, summary, files -> exit 3
example: {} -> exit 3 (W3 DL7)

name: latest
failure_behavior: missing argument -> argparse exit 2 (collides with coverage-regression code)
example: delta.py base.json -> exit 2 (W3 DL5)

name: --dispositions
valid_values: JSON list of {category, file (glob), symbol (glob, optional, default *), reason}
effect: matching findings never count as regressions; unmatched entries reported stale
failure_behavior: missing file -> stderr note, continue without; malformed -> exit 3
example: disposition for new stub2 -> exit 1 becomes 0; missing.json -> note, exit 1 (W3 DL2/DL3)
notes: W3 added; stale broad dispositions still mute (D-21)

name: --root
effect: where coverage checks look for files dropped from the latest scan
example: --root at an empty dir: dropped files count as deleted, verdict unchanged (W3 DL6)

name: --json
effect: emit JSON result instead of Markdown
example: W3 DL4 exit 1 with JSON body

name: GATING / SEVERITY_ORDER
effect: only new undispositioned critical/serious findings are regressions; severities come from the reports, config_hash never compared

name: --python
effect: interpreter used as python -m somnus_debug.cli for the 29 checks (expanduser only, no resolve)

name: [tool.hatch.build] exclude
effect: keeps doctor state/report/log artifacts out of built wheels/sdists
